title: Haye Bemar Ko Zanjeer Pinathe Hai Aadu
body:
Haye Bemar Ko Zanjeer Pinathe Hai Aadu
Kya Sitam Sayed-e-Sajjad Pe Dhathe Hai Aadu
Baad-e-ashoor Ke Qainounko Jalakar Ran Main
Ek Bimar Ko Ji Bharke Rulathe Hai Adu
<<DIVIDER>>
Chadarain Chinke Maa Behenoun Ke Sarse Hai Hai
Bhare Bazar Main Abed Ko Phirare Hai Adu
Be Kafan Baap Ke Laashe Ko Dikae Run Main
Hai Sajjad Ko Dkode Bhi Laga They Hai Adu
<<DIVIDER>>
Shiddathey Tabse Hai Dushwaar Samawa Uska
Har Qadam Durroun Pe Durre Bhi Lagathe Hai Adu
Saath Maa Behnounke Darbar Main Jana Ke Liye
Dushthey Bemar Ke Naizoun Se Chubathe Hai Adu
<<DIVIDER>>
Quld Se Fatima Zehra Ki Sada Ati Hai
Zeher Sajjed Ko Dukhe Se Polathey Hai Adu
Bada Shabbir Kabhi Chain Na Paya Tumhe
Hai Sajjad Teri Qabr Main They Ahi Adu
